body:
420 seeds placed in coffee grinder, consumed orally.
530: ate seeds
700: I feel great! Minor visuals while watching movie.
800-1130: everything is hilarious! I can't stop laughing, my face has began to hurt.
1130: go to park, standing on dock with a friend, still feeling great.
A few minutes later the lights start to go red,  I need to sit down. I woke up on the dock with a face full of blood and I have no idea where I am. My friend is screaming and crying next to. I feel fine again, I can't help but start to smile again. I try to calm her down and I ask her what happened.
'You said you didn't feel good, I went to sit down next to you you slumped over and fell face first off the bench, and started breathing very erratically then your body started shaking. Then you stop breathing for a few seconds. You looked dead for a few seconds then you looked at me like you wanted to kill me.'
I remember waking up and having no idea where I was. I knocked out part of my front teeth, bruised my eye and had bruises on the left part of my face. My heart beat was very irregular for 3 or 4 hours.
A very enjoyable trip until that happened.
